description: This Java source file implements a class 'CheckPermission' that models a <check-permission> element in a custom mini-language framework, used for runtime permission checks within the OFBiz framework. It parses XML configuration, performs permission validation, and manages error messaging related to permissions.

classes.name: CheckPermission
classes.description: Represents a permission check operation as defined by a <check-permission> XML element, handling permission validation logic and message management.

classes.name: CheckPermission.CheckPermissionFactory
classes.description: Factory class to instantiate CheckPermission objects from XML elements.

classes.name: CheckPermission.PermissionInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates permission details, including permission name and action, and provides a method to check permissions.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the permission check, updates error message list if permission not granted.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <check-permission> element.

methods.description: Factory method to create new CheckPermission instances from XML elements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the element 'check-permission'.

methods.name: PermissionInfo
methods.description: Constructor to initialize permission info from XML element and a method to check permissions.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has the specified permission/action.
